data.name: Shield Slam (Mythic)
data.description: Your shield bash produces a powerful kick. When using Shield Slam to bull rush, an opponent knocked prone because of an intervening wall or other surface also takes damage from the collision. The damage dealt is equal to d6 points. As an immediate action, you can expend one use of mythic power to add to your combat maneuver checks when resolving a bull rush made due to Shield Slam.
